calibration_rule: A number enters a production calibration only when its unit, process route, wafer diameter, system boundary, and assumptions are recoverable from a primary source.

sources.title: Imec grants public access to virtual fab for quantifying environmental impact of IC manufacturing
sources.system_boundary: public tool restricted to GHG Protocol Scope 1+2; private model is broader
sources.units: tool can present climate change, electricity, and water; no numeric result extracted from this page
sources.assumptions: generic high-volume manufacturing virtual fab; same model/process databases as private tool but fewer controls
sources.limitations: press page is not a numeric calibration table

sources.title: imec.netzero Public virtual fab
sources.node_coverage: not inspectable before account sign-in; official release states N28 onward
sources.system_boundary: generic HVM; public version; disclaimer says modeled technologies are not a specific manufacturer
sources.assumptions: numeric dashboard requires a public account and acceptance of terms
sources.limitations: no account was created and no authenticated dashboard values were extracted

sources.title: The Green Transition of the IC Industry
sources.node_coverage: advanced logic scenario; exact node not assigned to normalized Figure 4
sources.system_boundary: bottom-up gate-to-gate fab inventory; normalized example separates electricity, materials, and direct GHG
sources.assumptions: same advanced technology under high/low electricity mix and no/full abatement variants
sources.limitations: normalized scenarios cannot provide absolute wafer coefficients

sources.title: DTCO including Sustainability: Power-Performance-Area-Cost-Environmental score (PPACE) Analysis for Logic Technologies
sources.system_boundary: historical PPACE bottom-up technology-flow study; boundary differs from 2023 cradle-to-gate model
sources.units: per-wafer relative trends; electricity, UPW, GHG
sources.assumptions: historical process flows and historical gas utilization/abatement factors
sources.limitations: not interchangeable with updated imec.netzero v1.5.67 outputs

sources.title: The Environmental Impact of CMOS Logic Technologies
sources.limitations: official repository exposes metadata but not sufficient numeric tables for this campaign

sources.title: Cradle-to-gate Life Cycle Assessment of CMOS Logic Technologies
sources.source_type: peer-reviewed imec conference paper with public full text
sources.node_coverage: nine available/projected logic nodes from N28 through A14
sources.system_boundary: cradle-to-fab-gate; 300 mm generic HVM; excludes test, dicing, package, tools/infrastructure, fab waste treatment, and portions of Scope 3
sources.units: kWh/cm2, kWh/300 mm wafer equivalent, kgCO2e/wafer, kgCO2e/cm2, kgCO2e/die
sources.assumptions: 10x10 mm2 functional die; 86% Murphy die yield; 90% line yield; 17% facility share; 0.454 kgCO2e/kWh industry-average grid; IPCC 2019 Tier 2c abatement; imec.netzero v1.5.67
sources.limitations: graph-only absolute node values are not digitized into calibration; projected nodes are not measurements; public Scope 3 is incomplete

sources.title: Sustainable Semiconductor Manufacturing: The Role of Lithography
sources.units: not used numerically in this campaign
sources.assumptions: patterning must be evaluated at route/process-flow level
sources.limitations: metadata was public; numeric full text was not used

sources.title: ACT: Designing Sustainable Computer Systems with an Architectural Carbon Modeling Tool
sources.system_boundary: embodied plus operational system carbon; logic equation separates fab electricity, gas/chemicals, materials, area, and yield
sources.limitations: coarser than process-step imec model; default coefficients must not be mixed with mismatched boundaries

sources.title: Architecture Carbon Tool v3: Enabling Sustainability-aware Silicon System Design Exploration
sources.source_type: current first-party open-source model and technical brief
sources.node_coverage: configurable logic, DRAM, storage, packages, materials and passives
sources.system_boundary: configurable full-system embodied and operational carbon
sources.assumptions: ACT 3.0 README dated 2026-06-12; Python 3.12+; BOM-driven model
sources.limitations: technical brief is a 2026 preprint; repository defaults are not adopted as GREEN calibration

sources.title: CarbonClarity: Understanding and Addressing Uncertainty in Embodied Carbon for Sustainable Computing
sources.node_coverage: 28, 16, 10, and 7 nm examples; maturity analysis also uses 5 nm defect data
sources.system_boundary: ACT-style embodied carbon with uncertainty in yield, fab CI, EPA, and GPA; operational CI can also be distributed
sources.assumptions: Gaussian-kernel KDE over sparse public evidence; Poisson yield from time-varying defect density
sources.limitations: published distributions are not a substitute for missing SKY130 or imec node inventories

sources.title: The Environmental Footprint of IC Production: Review, Analysis and Lessons from Historical Trends
sources.node_coverage: historical and post-2010 IC production studies
sources.system_boundary: review explicitly classifies scope variation across 27 sources
sources.units: energy, carbon, and water normalized per cm2
sources.limitations: review values inherit heterogeneous source boundaries

sources.title: The Earth's Energy Budget, Climate Feedbacks, and Climate Sensitivity: Supplementary Material
sources.units: kgCO2e per kg gas for 100-year GWP
sources.limitations: GWP is not gas consumption, utilization, release, or abatement data

authors: World Business Council for Sustainable Development
sources.title: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and scope guidance
sources.system_boundary: Scope 1 direct; Scope 2 purchased energy; Scope 3 other value-chain indirect emissions

sources.title: TSMC 2024 Sustainability Report
sources.node_coverage: 8-inch average; N16-N90; N7-N10; N5; N3 reporting groups
sources.system_boundary: ISO 14067 product carbon footprint; report states wafer manufacturing and raw-material shares; not equivalent to imec generic-HVM boundary
sources.units: kgCO2e/wafer; kWh/12-inch-equivalent wafer mask layer; corporate tCO2e
sources.assumptions: calendar-year fleet and utilization affect results; 2023 product values reported in 2024 sustainability report
sources.limitations: node bins and foundry-specific boundary prevent direct imec coefficient substitution

sources.title: SkyWater SKY130 PDK documentation: background, status, and process rules
sources.node_coverage: SKY130 mature 180 nm-130 nm hybrid technology
sources.system_boundary: process identity, layer/mask rules, and PDK release status; no environmental inventory
sources.units: technology dimensions and design rules; no kWh/wafer or kgCO2e/wafer
sources.assumptions: open PDK is documented as an experimental preview rather than a production-qualified release
sources.limitations: supplies no node-specific fab energy, process-gas, yield, abatement, or wafer-carbon coefficient
